name: dream-catcher
description: Dream Catcher - A dream journal with AI interpretations

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const npmCmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const result = spawnSync(npmCmd, ['rebuild', 'sqlite3', '--build-from-source'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 0);"
